_comment: M13g settings-loader section (hand-pinned ground truth, NOT --record; same route as action_tree.json). TacticalAISettings.Load reads ONLY the named fields via Json.Get (TryGetValue) and never enumerates unknown keys, so a stale 'deployment' field left over in old PlayerPrefs saves from the removed deployment switch is silently ignored: no throw, no warning, no state change. Cases 1-2 pin the two historical values ('secret', 'open'); case 3 adds an unknown extra key on top. loaded_ok pins the absence of any exception (the section catches it explicitly). modeOverride absent in ToJson proves the new serialization writes no deployment field any more. Presentation/settings-only: planning behaviour and all Canon vectors are untouched, there is no Python sim twin. M13h (Thomas 28.10): DefaultExplainLevel changed post_hoc->none; case 3 (no explicit explain in save) now defaults to none, its pins updated accordingly. M13c (Thomas 30.10): new 'info' switch (RR info block, default ON) - ToJson gains '"info":...' (pins updated); cases 1-3 carry no 'info' key and must default to true (old saves keep the feature visible); case 4 pins an explicit false round-trip. Thomas 02.11: explain is a plain AN/AUS toggle now (ExplainLevelValues = none|full; AN == the old full/VOLL). 'post_hoc' is removed from the value set, so case 4 doubles as the migration pin: an old save carrying 'post_hoc' is coerced to the default 'none' (AUS) by Validate, no throw, and the info=false round-trip stays pinned. Thomas 02.11 (Personas persistence check): every case now pins the global persona default after Load (cases 1-4: absent in save -> empty string) and case 5 pins the full round-trip: stored id survives Load verbatim, is the LAST key of ToJson (the save-hook payload), a setter write re-serialises it, and ResetDefaults drops it again. The settings layer stores free-form ids by design (PersonaState is the validator).
